_readme: Per recording: expected = issues that must be flagged (rule + who said it); acceptable = debatable flags that should not count as false alarms; nearMisses = lines that must NOT be flagged under that rule. Quotes are the script wording; Transcribe may change them slightly.

expected.quote: Honestly, this fund basically can not lose.

acceptable.reason: Growth fund recommended with no discussion of goals or risk (short clip).

expected.quote: You're guaranteed to make at least eight percent a year, no matter what the market does.
Just sign today, and we'll go over the details later.
I can get you into a private crypto deal a friend of mine is running.
